title: Women in Summer Dresses at Outdoor Picnic, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of women and girls sit together on a wooden picnic bench shaded by a leafy tree during a sunny outdoor gathering. The woman in the foreground wears a short-sleeved plaid or checked cotton summer dress, while others wear floral printed day dresses and have their hair neatly pinned up in classic mid-century styles. Strong sunlight washes out the right side and background of the image, capturing a casual, candid moment of postwar leisure and community fellowship.
